title: Senior IA Inference Engineer (x/f/m)
description:
SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!

We are looking for a Senior Inference Engineer to join the ML Platform (TIGER) team in AI & Machine Learning.

Your mission will be to power Doctolib's AI-driven healthcare products - from Consultation Assistant to Phone Assistant and Health Companion - by owning the self-hosted LLM serving platform that keeps the most sensitive patient data within infrastructure Doctolib controls. You will build and operate the shared foundations that every AI feature team relies on: deploying, tuning, and scaling open-weight models across our GPU fleet, contributing directly to faster, safer, and more cost-efficient AI for care teams and patients across Europe.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Build the shared LLM serving foundations with MLOps engineers - define the serving stack, GPU capacity planning, and deployment automation for open-weight models (Gemma, Mistral, Llama, Qwen, and their fine-tuned variants) on Ray Serve / Anyscale, while shaping the evolution toward Kubernetes-based orchestration

- Own the model registry and promotion path - establish clear processes for versioning, validating, and promoting models into production, benchmark performance and output quality under realistic workloads, and maintain the curated model catalog together with the Agents Platform team

- Optimize inference performance and efficiency - operate and tune serving engines (vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT-LLM) to reduce time-to-first-token, inter-token latency, and cost per token through batching, caching, quantization, and parallelism strategies across our GPU fleet (L4 to H200)

- Own production reliability and disaster recovery - define SLOs, run load tests before launches, implement safe rollouts, rollbacks, and autoscaling, and participate in on-call and incident response

- Make serving performance and costs measurable - build Datadog dashboards, alerting, and cost reporting to track latency, GPU utilization, and inference spend, and identify opportunities to improve resource efficiency

- Keep the inference stack secure, compliant, and evolving - work with Security and Privacy on network isolation, data residency, and auditability, while continuously assessing new models, serving engines (such as SGLang), and GPU generations

WHO YOU ARE

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

- Have 5+ years of software or computer engineering experience, including hands-on production experience with at least one LLM serving engine (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, or Triton) - ideally having chosen, introduced, tuned, or scaled one in production, not just run it with defaults

- Are proficient in Python and Terraform, with a solid understanding of transformer inference mechanics: prefill vs. decode, KV cache, batching strategies, and why a model is compute- or memory-bound on a given GPU

- Have strong experience running GPU workloads on Kubernetes or a managed Ray / Anyscale platform, and a performance engineering mindset - you design reproducible benchmarks, read profiler output, and back decisions with numbers

- Are comfortable owning production reliability: observability, incident response, and on-call are a natural part of the role

- Have excellent communication and collaboration skills, high agency, a pragmatic build-vs-buy approach, and are comfortable working in a scope that is still taking shape

- Are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

- Have experience with distributed serving frameworks (KServe, llm-d, NVIDIA Dynamo), including disaggregated prefill/decode or KV-cache-aware routing, or with serving Mixture-of-Experts, multimodal models, or many LoRA adapters

description:

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll transport robots that build houses. You’ll load them at our Amsterdam workshop, get them onto construction sites, and bring them back for repairs before their next job. When a team needs a replacement robot to keep building, you’re the person who gets it there.

We’re hiring our first Robot Transporter. We already have 150+ robots in the field and we’re expanding from the Netherlands into the UK and US. You’ll be the first person dedicated to getting our robots, equipment and materials where they need to be, helping more teams build more homes.

Your day could take you from the workshop to several active construction sites, delivering robots, collecting systems for repair and getting equipment to the next crew. You’ll work out the order of stops, what fits in each vehicle, and how to load and secure it safely. You’ll drive a C1 truck or B-licence van, work closely with our deployment team, and get to know the robots and the people building with them.

This is practical, physical work with room to take charge. You’ll start by planning alongside the deployment team, then take ownership of routes and transport requests as you learn the sites and loads. Plans change, sites get muddy, and teams depend on you. You’ll see the houses going up and know you helped get them built.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Drive. Operate our leased C1 truck and B-licence van across the Netherlands, usually two or more movements a day. When a move needs a flatbed with forklift loading, you arrange it.

- Plan the day’s transport. Work with the deployment team on the day’s plan: what goes in which vehicle, and the order of drop-offs and pick-ups across sites, our Groningen hub and our Amsterdam locations. Over time, more of this becomes yours to own.

- Load and secure. Robots, hoisting cages, scaffolding, inventory kits, equipment. You know weight limits, lashing and what it takes to get a 400+ kg system in and out of a vehicle safely.

- Run deployment logistics. Systems, kits and operational tools out to a new site before the team arrives, back to the workshop when a build wraps, and everything in between.

- Keep the fleet where it's useful. Move idle systems from one site to another that needs them, and bring systems back for repair so that a broken robot swapped today is a wall going up tomorrow.

- Own the vehicles. Servicing, inspections, cleaning, fuel, damage reporting and fines. Vehicles are always road-ready.

• Lead product initiatives from idea to launch - discovery, scoping, prioritization, and shipping with design and engineering

What We're Looking For
Must-Have

• 5+ years of product management experience, ideally on B2B software

• Track record of owning a product area end-to-end and shipping outcomes (not just features) - comfortable being the most senior PM in the room with customers and partners

• Experience at a fast-moving growth-stage startup. You're comfortable with ambiguity, fast cycles, and owning outcomes without a playbook

• Strong product thinking - discovery, prioritization, scoping, shipping

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Nice to Have

Why Join Teton

• Competitive Salary and participation in our warrant program.

• Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

• A vibrant, learning-focused work environment.

• A role where you can make a significant impact on care delivery.

The Role:

Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.

You’ll join our customer project teams as one of the first technical faces of Celonis. You’ll work hands-on across the full integration toolkit: deploying our out-of-the-box extractors, building custom API connectors in a low-code environment, writing code for push-based ingestion, connecting Celonis to customer lakehouses and LLMs, and configuring writebacks, SSO, and user provisioning. Part implementation consultant, part integration engineer, part trusted technical advisor, this role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants broad exposure to enterprise architecture and modern data and AI integration patterns.

The work you’ll do:

Data integration and ingestion:

• Implement standard extractors. Install, configure, and troubleshoot Celonis out-of-the-box extractors in customer landscapes, including SAP (ECC and S/4HANA), JDBC-based databases, and cloud applications such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, and others.

• Build custom API connectors. Design and build custom connectors with Celonis Extractor Builder for source systems that expose data through REST or SOAP APIs, handling authentication (OAuth 2.0, API keys, certificates), pagination, rate limits, and incremental (delta) loads.

• Enable push-based ingestion. Help customers design and develop scripts and pipelines (typically in Python) that push data to Celonis via the Data Ingestion API, and advise on file formats, scheduling, and error handling.

• Connect to the lakehouse. Set up zero-copy data sharing between Celonis and customer lakehouses such as Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, including Delta Sharing configuration, access controls, and data freshness.

• Unblock infrastructure. Work through on-premise agent deployments, networking, proxies, firewall and IP allowlisting, certificates, and service-account permissions with customer IT and infrastructure teams.

• Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, monitor pipeline health, and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.

Actions, AI, and platform connectivity:

• Close the loop with writebacks. Configure Action Flows and other integration patterns that write back to customer systems (for example, updating records in SAP, Salesforce, or ticketing tools) so Celonis insights turn into action.

• Connect Celonis to AI. Help customers connect Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP (Model Context Protocol), covering authentication, permissions, and governance.

Identity, security, and governance:

• Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.

• Be the security translator. Support customer security, privacy, and compliance reviews, explain the Celonis architecture and data flows, and advise on topics like data minimization, pseudonymization, and least-privilege access.

title: Junior Social Media Video Editor
description:
About High Scale
We’re High Scale - a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition-that’s the DNA behind everything we do.
Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026-and we need a Junior Social Media Video Editor who speaks the language of the internet and can turn raw footage into viral gold.
Why This Role Matters
The "For You Page," the scroll, and the hook are your playground. As a Junior Social Media Video Editor, you aren't just cutting video; you are translating brand messages into native social culture. You will be responsible for taking raw influencer content and studio footage and turning it into snappy, engaging, and high-converting assets for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
Your work determines if a user stops scrolling or keeps moving. If you are obsessed with pacing, trends, and creating content that feels authentic to the platform, this is your launchpad.
What You’ll Do

•
Edit Native Short-Form Content

• Assemble and edit fast-paced, engaging videos specifically for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

• Master the art of the "hook"-editing the first 3 seconds to grab attention instantly using visual disruption, text overlays, and sound.

• Implement trending audio, native text styles, and platform-specific stickers to make ads feel organic.

•
Remix & Iterate

• Take successful ad concepts and create fresh iterations by swapping hooks, changing music, or re-ordering footage to combat creative fatigue.

• Turn long-form content (YouTube videos, podcasts) into bite-sized, viral social clips.

•
Polish & Enhance

• Apply dynamic captions (Alex Hormozi style, karaoke style, etc.) that increase watch time and retention.

• Perform basic color correction and audio mixing to ensure mobile-viewing quality.

• Add basic motion graphics and transitions to keep the energy high.

•
Stay Trend-Obsessed

• Monitor the TikTok Creative Center and Reels trends daily.

• Proactively pitch new editing styles, audio trends, or visual memes that we can apply to our client brands.

Who You Are

•
A Social Media Native

• 1-3 years of experience editing specifically for social media (personal brand, agency, or freelance).

• You live on the FYP. You understand current memes, pacing trends, and what makes a video go viral.

•
Technically Agile

• Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro (required).

• Familiarity with After Effects (for motion text) and CapCut (for specific trending effects) is a major plus.

• You understand aspect ratios, safe zones, and export settings for all social platforms.

•
Fast & Creative

• You can turn around an edit in hours, not days. You thrive on the speed of social media.

• You have a good sense of rhythm and timing-your cuts land perfectly on the beat.

•
Detail-Oriented

• You double-check spelling in captions and ensure audio levels are balanced for phone speakers.

• You are organized with your file management and project structures.

•
Excellent Communicator

• Strong English proficiency is required. You can clearly articulate why you made a creative choice and collaborate effectively with Art Directors remotely.

Perks & Benefits

• Growth Opportunities: Influence the creative direction of major brands and grow into a Senior Editor or Creative Strategist role.

• Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

title: Payments Operations Lead
description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

The role

The Payments Operations Lead brings Teya’s payments and settlement operations together into one reliable, well-controlled capability.

Today the operational work behind our outbound payments and merchant settlements is spread across many people and teams, and too much of it falls on our product teams, taking time away from building. This role changes that. You’ll own the day-to-day running of payments and settlements, standardise and document the core processes, put the right controls around them, and handle the steady stream of ad hoc issues that come with a fast-growing payments business.

It’s a hands-on, execution-focused role. You’ll be the first person in the capability, landing in a messy environment, bringing order to it and getting things done, with scope to add one or two people as it grows. You’ll work closely with Payments, Product, Finance, Compliance and Customer Operations, and with our banking and payment partners.

What’s in scope

- Outbound payments across SEPA, Faster Payments and SWIFT.

- Merchant settlements and payouts, including rejected and returned settlements.

- Reconciliation and the investigation and clearing of breaks.

- Returns, recalls and misdirected payments.

- Returning withheld and residual funds to merchants after they leave Teya.

- Banking and payment partner relationships, including the service levels we agree with them.

- Funding and liquidity across our operational accounts, working with Treasury.

- Testing and running our payment rails, working with our payment specialists.

What you’ll do

- Take ownership of payments and settlement operations that currently sit across multiple teams, and centralise them into a single, clearly owned capability.

- Map how each process runs today, then standardise, document and operate it, with runbooks that do not rely on product team time.

- Run the day-to-day execution of payments and settlements, making sure money goes out accurately and on time.

- Own the operational relationship with our banking and payment partners: agree service levels, track performance against them, and escalate and resolve issues when partners fall short.

- Work with Treasury to forecast and manage funding and liquidity across our accounts, so payments and settlements are never held up by an unfunded account.

- Work with our payment specialists to test and run our payment rails, including new rails, partner changes and scheme updates, before and after they go live.

- Put the right controls in place and keep them working: maker-checker and approval limits, reconciliation, safeguarding, sanctions screening and Confirmation of Payee on outbound payments, and handling of misdirected and fraudulent payments, working with Finance and Compliance.

- Own incident handling for payment and settlement failures, and work with Operational Resilience on continuity plans, since payments are among our most important services.

- Be the go-to person for ad hoc and unexpected payment issues: investigate,

title: Senior Insider Threat Investigator
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. Job Summary
The Insider Threat Investigator will contribute to the development, execution, and continuous improvement of Jabil ’s global Insider Threat Program. The investigator will identify, assess, investigate, and help mitigate insider risks that could affect Jabil ’s people, intellectual property, sensitive information, facilities, technology, operations, and reputation. This role requires a practical, prevention-focused approach that combines investigative skill, risk analysis, and sound business judgment. The investigator will work across a global manufacturing environment and collaborate with Security, Cybersecurity, Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, and business leaders while protecting confidentiality, employee privacy, and investigative integrity.

Job Description
The Insider Threat Investigator will receive and evaluate indicators of potential insider risk, conduct preliminary inquiries and assigned investigations, preserve evidence, and develop objective findings and recommendations. Matters may involve intellectual property or trade secret theft, unauthorized disclosure, fraud, misuse of systems or data, cybersecurity incidents, conflicts of interest, foreign influence or elicitation concerns, and other conduct that may create material risk to the company.
The investigator will gather and analyze information from authorized sources; review relevant security, human resources, compliance, and business records; conduct or support interviews; preserve evidence; identify information gaps; and maintain accurate and defensible case documentation. The investigator will work closely with cybersecurity and digital forensics analysts to obtain, interpret, and preserve technical evidence from SIEM and SOAR platforms, endpoint and network security tools, access-control systems, audit logs, authentication records, and other authorized sources.
The role will distinguish anomalous activity from legitimate business conduct by considering the employee’s role, access, relevant context, potential risk indicators, and corroborating information. The position will conduct and support risk assessments involving personnel, facilities, information systems, data, supply chains, third parties, and operations. The investigator will help determine scope and potential impact, develop proportionate mitigation options, monitor corrective actions, and prepare reports, case summaries, trend analyses, metrics, and briefings for program leadership and appropriate stakeholders.
The investigator will coordinate with relevant internal functions and may support engagement with law enforcement, government agencies, outside counsel, or other external partners when directed. All work must comply with applicable law, privacy requirements, records-handling standards, and strict need-to-know controls.
The role will also contribute to program development through research, policy and procedure updates, reporting pathways, awareness and training materials, case-management practices, exercises, audit and compliance responses, and lessons learned. Occasional domestic and international travel may be required for investigations, site reviews, training, audits, and stakeholder engagement.

Assumer la responsabilité du P&L. Répondre des revenus nets, de la marge, du BAIIA et des flux de trésorerie, avec des cibles annuelles claires, des contrôles financiers rigoureux et une utilisation judicieuse des ressources financières.

title: QA Engineer - Backend & Frontend
description:
At Qu you’ll find a fun, dynamic, and diverse culture that celebrates team and individual success. Our people are down to earth, trail blazin’ folks who value innovation.

Our technology team is a rapidly growing group of talented and experienced engineers building the leading enterprise software company focused on restaurant technology. We use modern technologies, automation, and AI-assisted engineering practices to build products that power restaurant operations at scale.

We are looking for a hands-on QA Engineer who is strong in both manual and automated testing, across backend APIs and frontend UIs. You'll test end-to-end flows that cross several Qu products, such as an order that starts in POS or web ordering and ends on the kitchen display. You'll make sure every case is tested at the right level, from API checks to end-to-end and manual tests.

You'll work inside Qu DLC, Qu 's AI-first delivery lifecycle. AI agents refine each story, propose its test cases, and write the tests before the code; people decide at review gates, on evidence. As the team's quality engineer, you own two of those gates: you approve the test cases before development starts, and you sign off the story when the test results are in.

What You'll Do Here

• Review the test cases AI agents propose from each story's acceptance criteria: tighten vague steps, add missing negative and edge cases, and approve them in AIO Tests.

• Review each story's test plan before development starts: the right test level for every case (unit, API, end-to-end or manual), and which existing tests to reuse, update or retire.

• Review, debug and fix the backend API and frontend UI tests that agents write in TypeScript and Playwright. Keep the shared fixtures, page objects and API clients healthy, and the smoke suite focused on critical paths.

• Run exploratory testing and the cases that stay manual, then sign off each story using the pipeline's results: smoke tests, the story's own tests and the AIO Tests run.

• Test end-to-end flows across services, such as POS, web ordering, the in-store server and the kitchen display, including scheduled and multi-channel orders.

• Investigate failing, flaky and blocked tests: read the pipeline's diagnosis, separate environment, test data and product issues, and fix the test plan or cases when they are the cause.

• Give feedback that improves how the AI agents write test cases and tests.

• Answer testing questions during story refinement, and partner with developers and product managers on release validation.

Experience We're Looking For

• 4+ years in QA or Qu ality Engineering, with hands-on experience in both manual testing and test automation.

• Strong test design and exploratory testing: turning acceptance criteria into clear test cases, finding edge and negative cases, and writing defect reports with precise repro steps.

• Knowledge of test levels (unit, integration, API, end-to-end) and when to use each.

• Hands-on UI and API automation with Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, including the Page Object Model, REST APIs and JSON payloads.

• Programming skills in TypeScript or JavaScript, or in another language such as Java or Python with readiness to work in TypeScript; strong enough to review and fix test code you didn't write.

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines (ideally Azure DevOps), Git and pull request reviews, and with debugging flaky tests and environment issues.

• Hands-on experience reviewing AI-generated test cases, tests or code, and deciding on evidence whether to trust them.

• Clear written and spoken English, and experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.

Bonus Experience

• Experience with agentic development tools such as Kiro, or with AI-first delivery workflows where agents generate tests and code.

Move your career forward while connecting countless people to the life- changing, quality care they deserve. We are seeking an experienced Principal, Product Manager, to lead eHealth’s eCommerce insurance marketplace and online consumer shopping experience. The ideal candidate is a strategic product leader who thrives in complex environments and is passionate about improving customer outcomes in healthcare.

You will design intelligent, personalized shopping experiences that clarify the historically challenging search for health insurance, earning consumer trust and maximizing conversion. This role will play a critical part in shaping the future of how online customers shop for healthcare by developing AI-first solutions. You will customize experiences for audience segments that range from brokers and employers seeking CHOICE (ICHRA) and traditional group coverage for their employees; individuals under 65 looking for individual and family plans; retirees turning 65 and aging into Medicare as well as individuals over 65 switching Medicare plans; and shoppers of all ages seeking gap and ancillary coverage (like dental, vision, and hearing) to supplement major medical coverage.

This role is responsible for defining the product strategy and roadmap, driving innovation across customer-facing experiences, and collaborating with cross-functional partners including engineering, data science, and business teams. Success in this role will be defined by the ability to improve the customer experience by delivering impactful product innovations and drive measurable business outcomes in a highly complex and evolving marketplace.
Key Responsibilities
Drive eCommerce Vision & Roadmap: Own the enterprise website strategy, priorities and roadmap, leading the online shopping and enrollment experience, turning the search for health insurance coverage into an intuitive, guided, high-converting e-commerce experience, prioritizing initiatives that maximize conversion, Average Order Value (AOV), and lifetime customer value (LTV) based on customer retention.
Implement AI-Native Experiences: Define and launch consumer-facing AI agents, chat-based enrollment guides, and non-deterministic engines designed to empower users to effortlessly and transparently search for plans, cross-examine benefits, premiums, compare Rx drug and doctor coverage, and understand out-of-pocket costs.

title: Global payroll manager
description:
ABOUT WATERSHED

Watershed https://watershed.com/ is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

THE ROLE

As our first dedicated payroll leader, you'll own payroll at Watershed end to end and build the controls, processes, and automation that let us grow headcount and geographies without growing manual work. You'll run payroll for our US and UK entities and oversee in-country payroll in Mexico and through our EOR partners.

This role is hands-on. You’ll run our day-to-day payroll operations while building the processes and automation that let the function scale as we expand. You'll partner closely with People Ops, Accounting, Legal, and Revenue Operations, and you'll be the go-to person for payroll questions across the company.

You will leverage AI and automation to streamline payroll workflows, applying strong judgment to determine where human oversight remains critical.

YOU WILL:

- Build the global payroll function: the documentation, processes, calendars, checklists, SOPs, and controls that let payroll scale with headcount, hire and develop a team as we grow, and lead the payroll side of expanding into new geographies.

- Own end-to-end global payroll, including new hires, terminations, salary changes, bonuses, commissions, and leave pay, and act as the escalation point for complex payroll issues and employee pay questions.

- Manage our in-country payroll providers and EOR partners across multiple countries, validating inputs and outputs, evaluate the right long-term model for each country, and evaluate payroll tools and providers, recommending what to adopt based on accuracy, cost, and risk.

- Own payroll configuration in Rippling and keep payroll data flowing cleanly to the general ledger as we scale, using AI and workflow automation to remove manual work.

- Administer deductions and retirement contributions, including 401(k) remittances, and reconcile plan contributions to the plan administrator.

- Maintain compliance with payroll taxes, wages, and statutory requirements across the US and the UK, including registrations, filings, year-end reporting, and responses to tax authority notices, and support financial statements, statutory, and 401(k) plan audits with documentation and responses to auditors.

- Administer sales commissions and other variable pay with Revenue Operations so plans are paid accurately and on schedule.

- Support equity-related payroll processes, including withholding and reporting on exercises and vesting events, in coordination with Legal and Carta.

- Partner with Accounting on payroll journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end close, with the goal of bringing payroll accounting into the payroll function over time, and with People Ops on employee lifecycle events (hires, terminations, leaves, and compensation changes) so the data flowing into payroll is accurate.

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU:

- Have 7+ years in payroll, or in finance or accounting with substantial global payroll ownership

- Have hands-on US & UK payroll experience. Experience with Mexico, Australia or Germany payroll is a strong plus.

- Have experience working with an EOR or PEO to cover countries without a local entity.

- Have hands-on experience with Rippling, including payroll-to-GL integrations.

- Enjoy partnering closely with HR, Accounting, Revenue Operations, and external providers to keep payroll accurate and on time.

title: SOC Engineer

In this role, your primary mandate will be building and evolving our security data lake, engineering reliable security telemetry, and owning high-fidelity detection engineering end-to-end. You will unify cloud, identity, endpoint, and application telemetry, staying on top of emerging threats to rapidly build and tune detections across our environment. Alongside this data and detection mandate, you will support incident investigations as needed to translate real-world threats into stronger automated defenses. This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical depth, understanding of modern software engineering and CI/CD systems, familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure (especially GCP), and expertise in security data pipelines and detection workflows.

What You'll Do:

- Security Data Lake & Detection Engineering: Architect, expand, and maintain our security data lake while designing, testing, and tuning custom detection rules to maximize threat coverage and minimize noise across our cloud-native stack.

- Investigation & Impact Analysis: Conduct targeted investigations to determine impact, analyze logs, telemetry, and system behaviors using SIEM, metrics, and Cloud Logging and identify gaps in detection/visibility.

Required Skills & Experience:

- Building and evolving the security data lake, unifying cloud, identity, endpoint, and application telemetry; hands-on experience with SIEM, Cloud Logging, and log-based investigation workflows.

- Engineering reliable security infrastructure and automation using infrastructure-as-code to close visibility gaps and perform log-based investigations.

- Proven expertise in detection engineering end-to-end, specifically developing, testing, and tuning custom detection rules to maximize threat coverage and reduce noise across complex environments.

- Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals (code structure, build systems, dependencies, package ecosystems).

- Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows.

- Solid knowledge of cloud architecture, especially Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services in modern cloud-native deployments.

- Familiarity with SaaS architectures, identity systems, and integration patterns.

Bonus Qualifications:

- Experience with threat intelligence, security research, or vulnerability analysis.

- Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, serverless infrastructure, or modern distributed systems.

- Ability to write scripts or small tools for investigation or automation (Python, Go, Bash).

- Experience working with bug bounty programs or coordinated vulnerability disclosure workflows.

description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE PRODUCT ENGINEERING TEAM

Product Engineering builds the power and cooling systems that let Fluidstack deliver gigawatt-scale AI data centers faster and denser than the grid-standard supply chain allows. The SST group is designing solid-state transformers as a core building block of that power architecture.

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Architect a medium-voltage solid-state transformer that can be manufactured, serviced, and scaled across gigawatt-scale campuses, not just demonstrated in a lab.

- Define the interface between the SST and the MVDC distribution system, including protection, control boundaries, and fault behavior.

- Build a semiconductor and magnetics supply strategy that survives a thin 10kV SiC market over a multi-year horizon.

- Take converter hardware from topology selection through working prototypes on a schedule that data center construction actually depends on.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own protection and grounding for every zone, from a bipolar medium-voltage DC bus carrying hundreds of megawatts over miles to the 1,500 V solar and battery bus and the 800 V racks.

- Specify, and where no product exists co-develop with vendors, the DC breakers, fuses, and disconnects for these buses, from medium-voltage feeders to hall buses carrying tens of thousands of amps.

- Design fault clearing without conventional breakers where possible, using SSTs that stop switching within microseconds, isolators that open at zero current, and fuses only where paralleled units can backfeed, and prove it in electromagnetic transient studies.

- Turn fault studies into requirements every SST, battery converter, and breaker vendor must meet: fault current contribution, interruption time, and coordination settings.

- Run live short-circuit and interruption tests on an energized multi-SST bus that prove the design to insurers, lenders, and the authority having jurisdiction.

Serving the People Who Serve the People
Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.
Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve-driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.
Want to know more? See more of what we do here.
Job Summary
Individual will focus on new cross-sell sales opportunity creation and win. This role is focused on selling to existing client partners at the local municipality level. They will be responsible for building a market plan, proactive and intentional outreach, and continue through all phases of the sales process culminating in sales win/close. This position is supported by an account specialist team, marketing team, solution consulting team, and technical project managers.

• Client partnerships range from small towns, villages, and cities

• Develop a comprehensive sales strategy and business plans to up-sell and cross-sell new products and services to existing client partners within their assigned territory

• Work to identify market trends, best practices, referrals, and new opportunity areas

• Lead all stages of the sales process from lead generation to win/close

• From cold calls to sales meetings, demonstrations to negotiation

• Virtual and face-to-face meetings

• Conduct initial qualification and discovery to determine client's current environment, potential projects, and challenges and goals to determine how Granicus solutions will help them achieve their goals

• Prepare engaging presentations and demonstrations to groups ranging from 1 to 25 stakeholders

title: Pacific Market Lead (Business Development)
description:
HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

As the Market Lead for the Pacific market, you'll have the opportunity to advance USGBC and GBCI's mission by increasing the adoption of green building products, services, and solutions while delivering measurable revenue growth.

The Market Lead is a revenue-generating sales role accountable for meeting or exceeding annual sales and revenue targets within a defined territory. You'll develop and execute territory-specific sales strategies, business development plans, and commercial activities to expand USGBC membership, LEED registrations and certifications, and other USGBC/GBCI products and services.

You'll work independently to build and manage a qualified sales pipeline, develop strategic relationships, negotiate and close new business, and achieve assigned revenue and product performance targets.

This position is responsible for one defined territory or market within the United States region. Commercial accountability, customer engagement, and sales execution will focus on that assigned territory, while collaborating with regional and global support teams as needed.

You'll represent USGBC and GBCI within your assigned market, cultivate relationships with members, customers, prospective buyers, and industry stakeholders, and convert those relationships into increased product adoption and revenue growth.

You'll lead business development across priority sectors and geographic areas within your territory, promoting USGBC/GBCI offerings such as membership, sponsorship, education, professional credentials, performance verification, project registration, and certification.

You'll also adapt approved marketing campaigns to local market conditions, strengthen strategic relationships, represent the organization at industry events, and contribute market insights and content that highlight sustainability leadership.

You will report to the regional director for United States Market Development and work closely with sales operations, customer account management, channel partner account management, client solutions, marketing and communications, and product teams to support effective commercial execution.

This role is ideal for a self-starter who thrives in an externally facing, growth-oriented environment and is motivated by purpose, performance, and measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

•
Territory Sales Strategy and Revenue Growth: Develop and execute a go-to-market plan for the Pacific market aligned with regional commercial priorities and organizational objectives. Drive annual sales and revenue targets for USGBC/GBCI products and services, including membership, sponsorship, professional credentials, project registrations, certifications, and other approved offerings. Identify priority customer segments, market opportunities, and commercial activities that support sustainable revenue growth within the assigned territory.

•
Business Development and Pipeline Management: Build and manage a qualified sales pipeline by sourcing, qualifying, advancing, and closing leads, prospects, and commercial opportunities through direct outreach, targeted campaigns, and approved partner channels. Develop prospect lists and activation plans by market and sector. Maintain accurate pipeline, opportunity, and forecast information in Salesforce. Take direct ownership of assigned new-business opportunities from initial engagement through commercial close, in accordance with approved sales processes.

•
Sales Execution, Negotiation, and Revenue Attainment: Negotiate and close new business, including memberships, sponsorships, and multi-product agreements, to meet assigned quarterly and annual sales targets. Apply consultative selling techniques to understand customer needs, position appropriate USGBC/GBCI offerings, and develop commercially viable solutions. title: Product Manager, Aperture
description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply.  Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and motivated full-time Product Manager, Aperture to help shape the product strategy for Tailscale's AI gateway. Aperture gives organizations visibility and control over how their teams use AI. It routes and secures LLM traffic through Tailscale's identity layer instead of distributing API keys, so security and platform teams can see who's using which models, enforce usage policy, and eliminate key sprawl. 

You'll be the first dedicated PM on this team, working directly with our co-founder and working alongside a small, AI-native engineering team to take Aperture from its current early-stage footing into a core part of how Tailscale's customers adopt AI safely. This is a foundational role: you'll bring product rigor and customer focus to a team that's moved fast and proven real demand, and you'll have outsized influence over what Aperture becomes as it matures.

Key Responsibilities

• Shape Aperture's product roadmap, in close partnership with our co-founder, Engineering Manager and the engineering team, translating a fast-moving, still-forming product area into clear priorities.

• Work directly with reference/design-partner customers to translate their AI governance and security needs into concrete product requirements.

• Partner with engineering to balance rapid prototyping with the production rigor required for an AI product customers depend on during their daily work.

• Represent Aperture externally - to customers, partners, and the community - as a credible voice on AI governance and enterprise AI adoption.

• Track and report on adoption, usage, and the metrics that matter for a product still establishing product-market fit.

• Partner with GTM and Customer Success as Aperture moves toward defined pricing and a repeatable sales motion.

What We Are Looking For

• 3-5 years of product management experience (can include experience in other technical customer facing roles, e.g. SE or FDE), including meaningful time in an early-stage or 0-to-1 product context 

• Comfort with ambiguity and fast, shifting priorities - this is a small team still defining its own scope.

• Experience building products for technical buyers (IT, security, or platform teams), since Aperture's customers are CISOs, platform engineers, and IT admins.

• Strong technical fluency - able to work credibly with engineers building in Go and go deep on identity, security, and AI-agent workflows.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to represent the product externally.

Nice to Have

• Prior product experience in AI/LLM infrastructure, developer tools, or identity/security products.

• Familiarity with the AI gateway landscape (e.g., LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway, Cloudflare AI Gateway) and how Aperture's identity-based approach differs.

• Experience partnering with GTM to bring a nascent product category to a defined pricing and sales motion.

• Public technical writing, conference talks, or community engagement.

• Hands-on experience with Tailscale, at work or at home.

title: Full-Stack Developer (Website & WordPress Migration)
description:
About AWISEE

AWISEE is a fully remote international marketing agency working across Search, Social and AI Visibility for brands in technology, AI, fintech, gaming and consumer. Our team builds the internal products behind the agency: a creator data platform that scans more than 100,000 creator profiles a day, and the tools our influencer marketing team uses to match creators with brands and run campaigns. We are a small team that ships weekly and uses AI tools in everything we build.
Team: Website · Experience: 3-5 years · Type: Full-time · Work mode: Remote · Location: Spain
About the role
You will own our website and the future of it. The site runs on WordPress today and is moving to Next.js with a headless CMS. You will keep the current site improving while you build its replacement, and carry the migration through without losing search rankings or traffic. Organic search is a core growth channel for us, so SEO is part of the job, not an afterthought.
What you will do

• Build the new website in Next.js and React.

• Set up a headless CMS so the marketing and content teams can publish without a developer.

• Plan and run the migration from WordPress: content, URLs, redirects, metadata and media.

• Own the SEO migration: URL parity, redirect mapping, structured data, sitemaps, internal links and pre- and post-launch checks.

• Handle technical SEO: Core Web Vitals, crawlability, indexing, hreflang and page speed.

• Fix issues and deploy new pages and changes on the current WordPress site while the new one is being built.

• Work with the SEO and content teams on templates for service, industry and blog pages.

• Use AI in the build and in the site itself where it adds value.

• Use AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) and Linear to plan and track work.

Must have

• 3+ years of full-stack web development.

• Strong Next.js, React and TypeScript.

• Strong WordPress: themes, plugins, PHP, and the REST API or WPGraphQL.

• Experience with a headless CMS (headless WordPress, Sanity, Strapi, Payload or similar).

• At least one website migration delivered with rankings and traffic intact.

• Solid technical SEO: redirects, canonical tags, schema markup, sitemaps and Core Web Vitals.

• Git and GitHub, and experience with hosting and deployment (Vercel, AWS or similar).

Nice to have

• Experience with multilingual or international sites.

• Google Search Console, GA4 and SEO crawlers (Screaming Frog, Ahrefs).

• Experience building free tools or interactive pages for lead generation.

• Background in a marketing or SEO agency.

Compensation
USD 850 - 1,250 per month, full-time, fully remote.
How to apply
Apply through this posting with your CV and links to websites you have built or migrated.
